profile.headline: Software Engineer with Top Secret Clearance
profile.summary: Goal-oriented and results-driven individual, ready to gain practical experience through an entry-level role in the field of Computer Science.

positions.title: Cloud Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer 
●  Develop and enhance full-stack application features using Java (Spring Boot) for backend services and React.js for the frontend in support of mission-critical DoD systems. 
●  Work with PostgreSQL databases, including data access, schema updates, and query validation. 
●  Implement and maintain unit tests using JUnit to support code coverage, reliability, and system 
stability. 
●  Use Git and GitLab for version control, merge requests, and code reviews within an 
Agile/Jira-driven development environment. 
●  Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support scalability, security, and performance 
requirements. 

Cloud Specialist / Lead 
● Led the design and implementation of the AWS cloud infrastructure applications, building the environment end-to-end based on program requirements. 
 		
●  Architected and configured secure AWS environments, including VPCs, EC2 instances, security groups, and IAM roles and policies, aligned with DoD security expectations 
●  Built and delivered a cloud-based demo environment for applications, enabling stakeholders to visualize system workflows and operational data. 
●  Researched, evaluated, and integrated third-party observability tools such as Grafana and Loki to support monitoring, analysis, and demonstration use cases. 
●  Implemented CloudWatch monitoring and dashboards to provide infrastructure visibility and support operational awareness. 
●  Served as the technical lead for cloud infrastructure efforts, balancing hands-on implementation with coordination and technical decision-making.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Enginee
positions.description:
-Developed and maintained full-stack web applications using C#, React, and Redux, ensuring seamless integration of front-end and back-end functionalities, while optimizing SQL database structures for enhanced application efficiency.
 -Participate in software testing efforts, including unit testing, integration testing, and end-to-end testing, to identify and resolve bugs, ensuring high-quality code delivery, while collaborating with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and define project scope.
-Utilized Agile methodologies to iterate and improve software development processes, fostering continuous integration and deployment practices, while actively contributing to code reviews and providing constructive feedback to peers for enhanced collaboration and knowledge sharing within the development team.
